title: The PS minority government of 2015
summary: The XXI Constitutional Government, a PS minority under António Costa, took office on 26 November 2015 with written agreements with the Bloco de Esquerda, the PCP and the Greens: the first time since 1974 that the parties to the left of the PS supported a government without joining it. The arrangement is known by a word first used against it, geringonça, a contraption that should not work.
